protocol.primary: Native brief totals.engages *60 / totals.duration_sec, candidate minus control within each order-pair. protocol.equivalence: Separate paired two-sided 90% Student-t CI strictly inside [-2,+2] engagements per match-minute, TOST alpha .05, and four-pair block-bootstrap 90% CI strictly inside the same bounds. Otherwise practical equivalence supports earlier drop consistent with noise. Nonsignificance alone is inconclusive; a significant robust increase means the earlier decrease was not reproduced.
protocol.existing_floor: Retain existing dm2 0.65 engagement-retention collapse threshold. Report candidate-0.65*control paired 90% CI: lower endpoint >0 supports non-inferiority at one-sided alpha .05; upper endpoint <0 confirms collapse. This secondary threshold cannot turn a reproducible smaller drop into noise.

bootstrap.method: Fixed consecutive non-overlapping four-pair blocks, resample 32 blocks with replacement and compute mean; percentile confidence intervals

protocol.power_limits: Planning model uses normal pair differences with conservative SD6 versus pilot SD2.3136; power simulations concern paired-t tests only, not a guarantee under drift, serial dependence or block-sensitivity agreement. No guarantee of resolving true effects at a bound.
protocol.secondary: Native goals, frags, deaths, stalls, lava_deaths, freezes, acquisitions, grabs with descriptive paired 95% CIs; no multiplicity-adjusted secondary claims. Report both run-order strata, CPU, native closest approach/coverage/avg_speed/freezes, flags, output volume and cadence/tails. Native band compare with primary engagements is contextual, never the statistical decision rule.
protocol.timing: Use identical BHVTIME probe. Discard first full five-second window for weighted mean cadence, retain all complete windows and >20/>50ms tails separately. Report mean difference 90% CI widened by +/-0.1ms for rounding; compare descriptively with +/-1ms. Last partial window unobserved.
